1.title: Big Almaty Lake
1.description: Journey through Presidential Park, Almarasan Gorge, and Ausai Waterfall, culminating at the stunning turquoise Big Almaty Lake surrounded by snow-capped peaks.
1.fullDescription: Join us on an unforgettable journey through some of Almaty's most scenic locations, culminating in the stunning Big Almaty Lake. On the way, we'll visit the serene Presidential Park, offering beautiful views of the Almaty mountains. We'll continue through the picturesque Almarasan Gorge, a peaceful retreat into nature, before making a stop at the hidden gem of Ausai Waterfall. Finally, we'll reach the highlight of the trip — Big Almaty Lake, where you'll be captivated by its vibrant turquoise waters and the surrounding mountain peaks. This tour offers a perfect blend of nature, beauty, and relaxation.

2.title: Medeu Shymbulak
2.description: Medeu — the world's highest winter sports complex — plus a 9 km cable car ride to Shymbulak at 3,200 m with breathtaking Tien Shan panoramas.
2.fullDescription: Medeu, the world's highest winter sports complex, is one of Kazakhstan's top attractions. A trip here offers breathtaking views of the Tien Shan Mountains and showcases Kazakhstan's tourism achievements. You'll enjoy the fresh mountain air and a scenic ride to the Shymbulak ski resort on a 9-kilometer modern cable car. The 60-minute ascent takes you from 1,690 to 3,200 meters, with the option of a glass-floor cabin for an unforgettable experience.

3.title: Almarasan
3.description: Almarasan Gorge, President Park, Ausai Waterfall and natural hot springs — where nature's beauty meets relaxation. Optional mountain spa experience at Tau Spa.
3.fullDescription: Embark on an unforgettable adventure through Almarasan Gorge, where the beauty of nature meets relaxation. This tour includes a visit to President Park, where you can stroll through lush landscapes and enjoy stunning views. Next, witness the majestic Ausai Waterfall, surrounded by serene nature, before rejuvenating in the natural hot springs, perfect for relaxation. If desired, you can indulge in a mountain spa experience at Tau Spa for ultimate wellness. Discover the breathtaking beauty of Almarasan Gorge with Crown Almaty Tours.

4.title: Kolsai Lake and Charyn Tour
4.description: Walk through Charyn Canyon's million-year-old formations, then drive 100 km to Kolsai Lakes — the pride of Kazakhstan whose name means 'gorge of lakes'.
4.fullDescription: For millions of years, wind and water carved unique natural sculptures from sedimentary rocks, constantly deepening the formed canyon. You will have a few hours to walk through the canyon and see the wonders of natural creativity. Next, we will drive additional 100 km from Charyn Canyon to have an excursion walk along the path leading around the largest of the lakes. Kolsay lakes are the pride of Kazakhstan. Translated from Kazakh, "kolsay" means "gorge of lakes".

5.title: Bear Waterfall and Assy Plateau
5.description: Visit beautiful lake Issyk and the high-mountain plateau of Assy for one day — scenic views, a nomad camp in the mountains, and alpine meadows of the Zailiyskiy Alatau.
5.fullDescription: On this one-day excursion you will visit the beautiful lake Issyk, surrounded by a tragic mystery, and the high mountain plateau of Assy. During the tour, you will enjoy the views of the most picturesque lake in the Almaty region and visit the nomad camp located in the mountains. This tour is suitable for lovers of beautiful landscapes and high mountains.

6.title: Altyn Emel
6.description: Martian landscapes, a mysterious singing dune, Red Book animals, and frozen lava in Kazakhstan's largest National Park — a tour that feels like another planet.
6.fullDescription: Touch the million-year-old secrets of nature in the largest National Park of Kazakhstan. A one-day tour to the National Park Altyn Emel is a great opportunity to visit the unique natural monuments of Kazakhstan. Martian landscapes, the mysterious singing of a dune, the Red Book animals and the frozen lava make this tour unforgettable. The feeling that you are on another planet during this tour does not leave you for a minute.

7.title: Konaev city, Nomad fortress and Tamgaly Tas tour
7.description: Over 1,000 petroglyphs, Buddhist inscriptions, and mysterious deity carvings on black rocks along the Ili River — dating back to the 12th century.
7.fullDescription: Just a few kilometers from the city of Konayev, on the right bank of the Ili River, there is a place that takes us back to ancient times. There are many petroglyphs, images of mysterious deities, late Buddhist inscriptions on the black rocks with a tan. There are about 1000 various rock paintings available to observe. Historians date the inscriptions and drawings to the 12th century. Not far from the altar, there is another stone with inscriptions on the ancient Turkic runic writing dating back to the 8th-9th centuries. Presumably they were left by the ancient tribes of the Kipchaks.

8.title: Issyk Lake
8.description: Issyk has an enchanting power — the water constantly changes color from gray to turquoise to green. It is possible to enjoy the calm beauty endlessly.
8.fullDescription: Issyk has an enchanting power. The water constantly changes color depending on the weather. When the sky frowns, then the lake turns gray, and under the bright sunlight, the water becomes blue, turquoise or green. It is possible to enjoy the calm beauty endlessly. A lot of instagramic sights are waiting for you on the road to Issyk Lake.

9.title: Oi-Qaragai
9.description: Just 40 minutes from Almaty — horse riding, ski slopes, a rope park and mountain tranquility. The perfect family getaway where nature meets comfort.
9.fullDescription: Just a 40-minute drive from Almaty, you can enjoy a family vacation in nature, ride the ski slopes or ride horses at the hippodrome. Now you don't have to choose between nature and comfort. At the resort, you can ride horses, give your child the joy of communication and relieve stress away from the noisy city. For outdoor enthusiasts, more than 22 kilometers of the best ski slopes are offered. For children, a rope park, riding ponies, and much more are offered. Your child will be happy!

10.title: Astana City Tour
10.description: A sightseeing tour around the main attractions of Kazakhstan's capital. Visit Baiterek, EXPO, Khan Shatyr, Hazret Sultan Mosque, the embankment, and the city's best modern locations.
10.fullDescription: Discover the futuristic capital of Kazakhstan on a comprehensive sightseeing tour covering its most iconic landmarks. From the legendary Baiterek observation tower to the EXPO 2017 pavilions, the magnificent Khan Shatyr entertainment centre, and the grand Hazret Sultan Mosque — this tour showcases why Astana is one of Central Asia's most extraordinary cities. A relaxing drive along the embankment reveals the city's best modern architecture and scenic views. Perfect for first-time visitors who want to see all the highlights in one day.
included: Photo stops at all key sites

11.title: Night Astana Tour
11.description: Discover the unique atmosphere of Astana at night with stunning city lights and modern architecture. The tour includes the best evening locations, photo spots, restaurants, and a relaxing city drive.
11.fullDescription: Astana transforms completely after dark. Neon-lit towers, illuminated bridges, and glowing fountains create a dazzling visual spectacle unlike any other city in Central Asia. This evening tour takes you on a curated drive through the most photogenic night spots — from the glowing Baiterek to the lit-up embankment — with stops for photos and a relaxed city drive through the illuminated boulevards. Perfect for content creators and photography enthusiasts.

12.title: Burabay Tour
12.description: A trip to Burabay, one of the most beautiful natural destinations in Kazakhstan. Lakes, mountains, fresh air, and breathtaking landscapes make it a perfect getaway near Astana.
12.fullDescription: Burabay National Park — known as the 'Switzerland of Kazakhstan' — is a stunning natural reserve just 240 km north of Astana. Ancient granite rocks rise dramatically from crystal-clear lakes surrounded by pine forests. The park is home to Lake Burabay, the iconic rock formations of Borovoye, and the legendary Zhumbaktas boulder. Whether you choose a one-day sprint or a relaxed two-day stay, Burabay offers an unforgettable immersion in untouched Kazakh nature.

13.title: Historical & Cultural Tour
13.description: Explore the history and culture of Kazakhstan by visiting museums, national landmarks, mosques, and cultural centers in Astana.
13.fullDescription: Astana is not just about futuristic architecture — it carries the rich heritage of the Kazakh nation. This cultural tour takes you inside the grand National Museum of Kazakhstan, home to thousands of artifacts spanning nomadic history to Soviet-era life. You'll visit the magnificent Hazret Sultan Mosque, one of Central Asia's largest, and explore the Palace of Peace and Reconciliation. A knowledgeable guide brings Kazakh traditions, customs, and historical context to life throughout the tour.

14.title: Aktau City Tour
14.description: Discover the main resort city on the coast of the Caspian Sea. Beautiful embankments, the best viewpoints, modern districts, and the unique atmosphere of a seaside city.
14.fullDescription: Aktau is Kazakhstan's only coastal city — a sun-drenched resort on the eastern shore of the Caspian Sea. This city tour takes you through its most scenic embankments, striking modern districts, and the best viewpoints overlooking the sea. Discover the unique blend of Soviet-era architecture and contemporary development that gives Aktau its distinctive character. Photo stops are included at every key location along the route.
included: Photo stops at all key sites

15.title: Bozzhyra Tour
15.description: Travel to one of the most incredible places in Kazakhstan. Unique canyons, cliffs, and breathtaking landscapes of Mangystau. A true adventure for nature lovers and photography enthusiasts.
15.fullDescription: Bozzhyra is one of the most dramatic landscapes on Earth — a vast white plateau sliced by deep canyons, with solitary rock spires rising from an ancient seabed in the heart of Mangystau. This off-road jeep tour takes you deep into this alien terrain, stopping at the most breathtaking viewpoints over the canyon system. Whether you come for photography, adventure, or simply to witness something truly otherworldly, Bozzhyra will leave you speechless.

16.title: Caspian Sea Tour
16.description: Relax by the seaside with beautiful sunsets, walks, and the best beaches of Aktau. A perfect option for peaceful relaxation and photo sessions.
16.fullDescription: The Caspian Sea at Aktau offers some of the most serene seaside scenery in Central Asia. This flexible tour takes you to the best beaches, scenic coastal viewpoints, and the most spectacular sunset spots along the shore. Whether you want a peaceful family day by the water or a golden-hour photography session with the vast Caspian as your backdrop, we'll tailor the experience to your wishes.

17.title: Almaty City Tour
17.description: Discover Almaty's most iconic landmarks — the Kok Tobe TV tower, Zenkov Cathedral, Kazakhstan Hotel, Green Bazaar, and Republic Square park — all framed by the snow-capped Tian Shan mountains.
17.fullDescription: A curated sightseeing tour through the highlights of Almaty, Kazakhstan's largest and most vibrant city. You'll visit the legendary Kok Tobe TV tower with its sweeping panorama, the ornate Zenkov Cathedral — one of the tallest wooden churches in the world — the Soviet-era Kazakhstan Hotel fountain square, the colourful and lively Green Bazaar, and the grand Republic Square park with the iconic colonnade framed by Tian Shan mountains. A perfect first introduction to the city.

1.text: The Charyn Canyon tour was absolutely breathtaking. Amir knew every viewpoint and the route was perfectly paced. Best day of our trip!

2.text: We did a custom 3-day itinerary covering Kolsai Lakes and Charyn. Everything was arranged smoothly — hotel, transport, meals. Highly recommend.

3.text: Big Almaty Lake in the morning light was magical. Our driver was punctual, careful, and very friendly. Will book again on our next visit.

4.text: Aigerim made the city tour come alive with stories about Kazakh history. She showed us places no guidebook mentions. A truly special experience.

5.text: Stunning trek up to Ile-Alatau — the guide matched our pace perfectly and knew exactly when to pause for photos. The mountain views were worth every step.

6.text: Came all the way from India and this tour was the best decision. The Kolsai Lakes overnight stay was dreamlike — woke up to complete silence and crystal water.

7.text: The Charyn Canyon sunset tour was spectacular. Our driver was safe and knowledgeable, and the timing of arrival was perfect for golden hour light.

8.text: Did the Turgen Gorge waterfall hike as a solo traveller and felt completely safe. The guide made sure I reached every best viewpoint on the trail.

9.text: Booked the multi-day Altyn-Emel trip on short notice and they handled everything — tent, food, permits. The singing sand dune was unlike anything I've experienced.

10.text: Perfect private tour for our family. The driver was patient with our kids and the guide adjusted the pace so everyone could enjoy. Totally stress-free day.

11.text: We came for a winter tour and weren't disappointed. Shymbulak in the snow is breathtaking and the team was prepared for cold conditions. Highly professional.

12.text: My first time in Central Asia and Crown Services made it unforgettable. Combining city sights and nature in one day was a brilliant idea. Already planning my return.

13.text: The Big Almaty Lake plus Kok-Jailau trail combination was exactly what I wanted. Longer than expected but our guide kept energy high with great mountain stories.

14.text: Five-star service from first message to the last drop-off. Snacks, warm tea at altitude, spare layers — the attention to detail showed real care for every guest.

1.title: Bishkek City Tour
1.description: A comfortable introduction to Bishkek, the capital of Kyrgyzstan. The tour covers the main landmarks, parks, squares, and the city's most popular spots — a blend of Soviet architecture, modern districts, and leafy green streets. Your guide will bring the history, culture, and everyday life of the capital to life.

2.title: Issyk-Kul Tour
2.description: A journey to Kyrgyzstan's most famous lake. Comfortable transfer from Bishkek through scenic mountain roads with stops at viewpoints along the way. At the lake: beach walks, swimming in clear water, and the option to visit natural hot springs.

3.title: Skazka Canyon Tour
3.description: A thrilling jeep tour to one of Kyrgyzstan's most unique natural canyons. The route follows the scenic southern shore of Issyk-Kul to dramatic red and orange rock formations that look like a fantasy world — with the best photo spots and a canyon sunset.

4.title: Karakol Tour
4.description: A journey to the Karakol mountain region — one of Kyrgyzstan's most beautiful areas. The tour follows the Issyk-Kul shoreline with stops, then explores the town. In summer: trekking through gorges, waterfalls, and mountain hikes. In winter: skiing at the famous Karakol ski resort.

5.title: Kel-Suu Tour
5.description: An expedition tour to one of Kyrgyzstan's most remote and beautiful lakes. The route crosses high-mountain passes before revealing a breathtaking turquoise lake surrounded by cliffs. A full adventure — jeep transfer, overnight in yurts or a camp, and total immersion in untouched nature.
